name: scorpio-native
description: **Project Scorpio** is a modern Progressive Web Application (PWA) designed for speed, clarity, and offline-first usage. It delivers a minimalist yet powerful note-taking experience with rich editing tools, folder organization, user profiles, and seamless cross-platform support.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
